title: Compute the difference in total view counts between posts authored by users
question: Compute the difference in total view counts between posts authored by users with the lowest reputation and posts authored by users located in the United Kingdom who have posted at least one comment containing a URL.

prediction.sql: WITH low_rep AS (SELECT MIN(XCL_053) AS min_rep FROM users), uk_url_users AS (SELECT DISTINCT u.XCL_052 FROM users AS u WHERE u.XCL_058 = 'United Kingdom' AND u.XCL_052 IN (SELECT c.XCL_010 FROM comments AS c WHERE c.XCL_008 LIKE '%http%')), low_sum AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.XCL_030), 0) AS s FROM posts AS p JOIN users AS u ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033 WHERE u.XCL_053 = (SELECT min_rep FROM low_rep)), uk_sum AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.XCL_030), 0) AS s FROM posts AS p JOIN users AS u ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033 WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (SELECT XCL_052 FROM uk_url_users)) SELECT (SELECT s FROM low_sum) - (SELECT s FROM uk_sum) AS diff

arguments.sql:
WITH low_rep AS (
  SELECT MIN(XCL_053) AS min_rep FROM users
),
uk_url_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.XCL_052
  FROM users AS u
  JOIN comments AS c ON c.XCL_010 = u.XCL_052
  WHERE u.XCL_058 = 'United Kingdom'
    AND c.XCL_008 LIKE '%http%'
),
low_sum AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.XCL_030), 0) AS s
  FROM posts AS p
  JOIN users AS u ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
  JOIN low_rep AS lr ON u.XCL_053 = lr.min_rep
),
uk_sum AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.XCL_030), 0) AS s
  FROM posts AS p
  JOIN users AS u ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
  JOIN uk_url_users AS uu ON uu.XCL_052 = u.XCL_052
)
SELECT (SELECT s FROM low_sum) - (SELECT s FROM uk_sum) AS diff

WITH low_rep AS (
  SELECT MIN(XCL_053) AS min_rep FROM users
),
uk_url_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.XCL_052
  FROM users AS u
  WHERE u.XCL_058 = 'United Kingdom'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM comments AS c
      WHERE c.XCL_010 = u.XCL_052
        AND c.XCL_008 LIKE '%http%'
    )
),
low_sum AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.XCL_030), 0) AS s
  FROM posts AS p
  JOIN users AS u ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
  WHERE u.XCL_053 = (SELECT min_rep FROM low_rep)
),
uk_sum AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.XCL_030), 0) AS s
  FROM posts AS p
  JOIN users AS u ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
  WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (SELECT XCL_052 FROM uk_url_users)
)
SELECT (SELECT s FROM low_sum) - (SELECT s FROM uk_sum) AS diff
